content: CanIf shall provide wake-up service CanIf_CheckValida- tion() only, if • underlying CAN Controller provides wake-up support and wake-up is enabled by the parameter CanIfCtrlWakeupSupport and by CanDrv configuration • and/or underlying CAN Transceiver provides wake-up support and wake-up is enabled by the parameter CanIfTrcvWakeupSupport and by CanTrcv con- figuration • and configuration parameter CanIfPublicWakeupCheckValidSupport is enabled.

CanIf shall provide wake-up service CanIf_CheckValida- tion() only, if • underlying CAN Controller provides wake-up support and wake-up is enabled by the parameter CanIfCtrlWakeupSupport and by CanDrv configuration • and/or underlying CAN Transceiver provides wake-up support and wake-up is enabled by the parameter CanIfTrcvWakeupSupport and by CanTrcv con- figuration • and configuration parameter CanIfPublicWakeupCheckValidSupport is enabled.
